Now let me add a regression test. I'll model it on `test_get_conflicted_files_non_ascii`. Let me first test what the expected result is with the fix.

The non-ascii test:
```python
def test_get_conflicted_files_non_ascii(in_merge_conflict):
    open('интервью', 'a').close()
    cmd_output('git', 'add', '.')
    ret = git.get_conflicted_files()
    assert ret == {'conflict_file', 'интервью'}
```

Interesting - here they don't call resolve_conflict(); instead `git add .` which resolves the conflict_file (adds current content) plus adds интервью. So write-tree works. Output = {conflict_file, интервью}. Note интервью is a new file in the merged tree relative to HEAD/MERGE_HEAD.

```python
    assert ret == {'conflict_file', 'HEAD'}
```
